_comment: Status effects. The engine applies hungry/starving/tired/exhausted/hypoxia/suffocating/cold/demoralised/inspired/resting by itself (defaults in game/sim/needs.py); entries here override those numbers or add effects for items and scripts.

well_fed.name: Well Fed
well_fed.desc: Real food. Morale improves on its own.

stimmed.name: Stimmed
stimmed.desc: Borrowed energy. The bill arrives later.

calm.name: Calm
calm.desc: The noise in your head has turned down.

signal_touched.name: Signal-touched
signal_touched.desc: A pressure behind the eyes, like a word on the tip of your tongue.

authority.name: Audit Authority
authority.desc: The Administrator has given you the run of the station's control boards.
